Crash Test Creature is a test NPC. It may have been used to test crash logs or other features related to crashing. The exact nature of this creature may be shrouded in mystery, but no guess work is needed as for the results of encountering it. We need look no further than the succint original name: :(CRASHES EVERYTHING HOLY CRAP! STAY AWAY~ PROBABLY POSSESSED BY DEMONS OR SOMETHING... CANT EVEN BE DELETED) It was ironically renamed at some point, due to further complications caused, during testing, by the very name.

The Creation Catalyst Console is located in the Catalyst Gardens of Zereth Mortis. It acts as a point of access to the catalyst system, allowing players to convert gear into equivalent tier set pieces. The console is unlocked by completing The Catalyst Awakens, which becomes available at the end of the Zereth Mortis campaign's fourth chapter.

Addons can register a category within the "AddOns" tab of the game's Settings panel, giving them an intuitive place for users to find the addon's settings. This guide explains how to create a settings menu using this method. As of patch 10.0.0 there are two layouts that can be used to do this: the canvas layout and the vertical layout. Both of these add a menu entry for the addon and allow for nesting pages underneath the main entry, but they have different methods for defining the actual contents of the created settings pages.
